method: Built-in image_gen tool; four transparent material-object edits and one blank ground edit using inspected local photographic references. No CLI/API key or external provider activation.
world: Existing Neotoma Tension and Trace: fresh cream cut paper, tactile fine fibers/edges, navy ink added by code, restrained rust/sage/blue materials, soft coherent NWlight/contactshadow, true90degree top-down flat-lay.

coordinate_contract.sprites: All four nativecanvases1254x1254pixels. Rectangles are [left,top,right,bottom], portpoints [x,y] in full nativecanvas coordinates.
coordinate_contract.crop: Recommended crop_rect includes all meaningful paper/contactshadow alpha>=2 with8px margin. Sparse alpha1 noise outside is optically negligible and intentionally excluded by the SVGviewBox crop. Original raster bytes remain unchanged.
coordinate_contract.placement: Use nestedSVGviewBox or equivalent existingcomposition transform for crop selection. Preserve aspectratio; do not stretch square nativecanvas to the final objectbox. All coded ink and ports use exactly the same crop/scale/translation mapping as the material.
coordinate_contract.aspect: Observation meaningful crop is~1.99:1; a160wide observation should be about80high, not stretchedto105high. Envelope crop~1.69:1. Documentcrop~0.778:1. Dossiercrop~0.812:1.
coordinate_contract.port_status: Suggested physically attached nativeportpoints verified by read-only pixel sampling: alpha252or253 at each point. Final route/marker sizing belongs to builder; these are geometry anchors, not already painted pins.

light_shadow_contract.camera: Strict topdown normalpaperplane; opticalaxis90degrees, edgeshorizontal/vertical, no isometricorobliqueview.
light_shadow_contract.light: One soft NW/upper-leftlight. Material/highlight and narrowbakedcast/contactshadow fall toward SE/lower-right.
light_shadow_contract.allowed_motion: Fixedorientation2Dtranslation ONLY. Entire materialcutout, bakedcontactshadow, codedink andpins share one transform. Keep objectelevation/scaleconstant duringtheactualmotion.
light_shadow_contract.not_supported: No rotation,lift,flip,perspectivetilt or changingelevation without separately prepared shadows/hidden surfaces. Translating a narrowbakedshadow atfixedorientation is the documented boundedapproximation.
light_shadow_contract.assembly: Groundatback; shadows/bodymaterial then surfaceink; exposedcrossobjectconnectors then foregroundpins unless an explicitphysicalfoldmask requiresotherocclusion. Reusequalifiedinvoiceport/paint principles.
light_shadow_contract.alpha: Truealpha observed: outside containsalpha0, edges/contactshadowpartialalpha; centralpaperisnearopaquealpha253ratherthanexact255. There is no opaque backgroundrectangle. Do not harden/composite alpha into a matte without actual review.

document-packet.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / production photographic cutout. The input image is a MATERIAL/LIGHTING REFERENCE only. Reconstruct the requested isolated object for a hybrid animation sprite in the SAME fresh tactile Neotoma paper world: realistic fine paper fibers, natural cut edges, thin believable paper thickness, restrained cream/sage/blue palette, soft coherent light coming from upper left/NW with a narrow natural contact shadow toward lower right/SE. STRICT TRUE TOP-DOWN CAMERA, optical axis exactly90degrees to the paper plane, orthographic flat-lay: no oblique angle, no isometric view, no keystone perspective, no visible tall side walls. Edges align horizontally/vertically, not a rotated composition. Transparent background with real alpha. Only the single requested object and its very narrow semitransparent contact shadow; no tabletop/ground/opaque rectangle. Plenty of transparent padding, every edge and shadow entirely inside canvas. Square canvas. No words, text, letters, numerals, logos, navy rules, printed ink, symbols or decoration: the central face must be BLANK because exact semantic marks will be coded later. No watermark. Fresh refined stock, not grubby, distressed, old, crumpled or grunge. Do not substitute a vector or CAD illustration. Subject: one portrait rectangular PDF-like document packet, about3:4 aspect ratio, three thin cream sheets stacked with tiny2–4pixel offsets visible at bottom/right. Entire top sheet is smooth and blank, with a subtle natural paper edge and a very small folded top-right corner. The principal page face is flat and uninterrupted. No folders, tab or envelope. Fill about75percent of canvas height, centered.
